name: Transformer Block
question: What happens to a sentence inside one transformer block?
problem: Attention lets words share context. On its own it can't store facts, and a deep stack of it loses the original meaning on the way through.
points: Words become embedding vectors, with position tags so the order survives.
Each block runs attention (words share context), then a feed-forward network (each token looks up stored facts on its own).
Skip connections carry the original vector around each step, so the meaning isn't erased.
title: Transformer Architecture Explained in 3 Steps #shorts
